name: lib_real_sqrt_sub_sqrt_bounds
statement: (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) : (b - a) / (2 * Real.sqrt b) ≤ Real.sqrt b - Real.sqrt a ∧ Real.sqrt b - Real.sqrt a ≤ (b - a) / (2 * Real.sqrt a)
closed: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b), (b - a) / (2 * Real.sqrt b) ≤ Real.sqrt b - Real.sqrt a ∧ Real.sqrt b - Real.sqrt a ≤ (b - a) / (2 * Real.sqrt a)
informal: Two-sided mean-value bound for the square root: (b-a)/(2√b) ≤ √b - √a ≤ (b-a)/(2√a) for 0 < a ≤ b (the telescoping estimate behind ∑ 1/√k ~ 2√n). Promoted and generalised from Mathlib2.an2_sum_inv_sqrt_bounds_aux1 (the case b = a + 1; used in bld_sum_inv_sqrt_div_sqrt_tendsto).
